title: Plasma Orb Girl
description: A glowing plasma globe with bright blue and pink electrical tendrils radiating from a central orb. Inside the transparent sphere, the face of a young girl with dark hair and a tear on her cheek is visible, merged with the energy streams against a starry black background.
prompt: A surreal plasma globe sitting on a dark wooden surface, its transparent sphere filled with vibrant pink and blue electrical arcs radiating from a glowing central electrode. The face of a young girl with dark hair, wide eyes and a single tear is faintly visible within the glass, merging with the energy streams, cosmic starry background, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
